CITY OF LA VERNE
  SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  AGENDA

Terry Kistler, Chair  La Verne Community Center
Bette Donovan, Member  Classroom 1
Edward Padgett, Member  3680 D Street
Scott Snider, Member  La Verne, CA 91750
Jenny Jolly, Member  (909) 596-8776
George Borst, Member
Yvonne Duran, Staff Liaison
Armando Cisneros, Staff Liaison
Robyn Olsen, Staff Liaison

  Wednesday, March 19, 2025 – 10:00 a.m.
  La Verne Community Center Classroom 1

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
La Verne Community Center at (909) 596-8776 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Public comments will be allowed near the conclusion of the meeting.

  1. ROLL CALL – Terry Kistler, Bette Donovan, Edward Padgett, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly,
  George Borst

  2. PRESENTATIONS – Lonnie Shipman, Community Risk Reduction Specialist, La Verne
  Fire Department

  3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES – February 19, 2025

  4. DISCUSSION & ACTION ITEMS
  a. Senior Nutrition Program – Armando Cisneros
  b. Bingo Report – George Borst
  c. Account Balance Update – Armando Cisneros
  d. Monthly Senior Program Fees – Armando Cisneros
  e. Mt. SAC Classes Update- Armando Cisneros
  f. Aging Next – Armando Cisneros
  g. Outstanding Older American – Armando Cisneros
  h. Facilities Report – Yvonne Duran
  i. Upcoming Events – Robyn Olsen
   5. PUBLIC COMMENT
  Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject
  matter jurisdiction of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda
  items except as provided by law.

  6. STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION/INFORMATION

  7. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 a.m. on April 16th at the La Verne Community Center, 3680 D Street, La Verne CA
  91750.

Posting Statement: On March 13th, 2025 a true and correct copy of this Notice was posted on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.cityoflaverne.org
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 16, 2025

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, March 19, 2025.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, George Borst,
  Jenny Jolly, Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn
  Olsen, Community Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, February 19 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Lonnie Shipman, Community Risk Reduction Specialist, La Verne
  Fire Department. He gave an informative presentation regarding fire prevention,
  property inspections, construction inspections, and other duties performed by
  the Fire Department. Shipman also explained some simple things to do when it
  comes to fire prevention within your own home. He also explained to have a “Go
  Bag” ready for any emergency. Information regarding Community Emergency
  Response Team (CERT) training can be found at LAFD.org. More information can
  be found on various websites such as FIREWISE.ORG and LAVEREFIRE.ORG.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 474 meals were served to an average of 26 participants in
  February.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: Bingo receipts totaled $1139.00. Ending balance in the account
  through February was $15.00. Liabilities to Bingo West were $658. Liabilities
  to the City of La Verne, $454.00. The average number of players in
  attendance per week is 70 for the month of February.

5. Account Balance: $3,417.19.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Spring session began on Monday, February 24. Registration for
  Summer/Fall 2025 will be on Tuesday, May 27 from 10:30AM-12:30PM.

8. Outstanding Older American: The Committee voted on this year’s Outstanding Older
  American. Bonnie Brunel from the Heritage Foundation was named this year’s
  recipient for the award.

9. Aging Next: 7 La Verne Residents were served in February. One was served
  via the Joslyn Center and 6 served via the Aging Next office.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: The roof in SCR is getting checked for leaks that happened
  from the last rainstorm.

11. Upcoming Events:

  •  Thursday, March 27 – Excursion: The Grove Farmers Market and Griffith Observatory, 1:00PM-
  10:00PM.
  •  Wednesday, April 2– Senior Seminar: Funding Aging in Place Services with Your Home Equity,
  Presented by Longbridge Financial, 9:30AM.
  •  Thursday, April 10 – Excursion: Temecula’s Treasures and Traditions: A Day in Old Town, 9:00AM-
  4:30AM.
  •  Monday, April 14 – Movie Matinee: The Help, 12:30PM.

  Public Comments: George Borst informed the committee of a rise in the number of
  Bingo participants due to some new people from West Covina attending.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:55AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, March 19, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
